opacityGraphics: 727's sprite texture op (type 39) hands the texture RGB only, and the per-pixel alpha comes from the texture's opacity output, so every RS3 texture with partial alpha needs a second sprite holding the alpha as grey; all three do, and they take the next three graphic ids after the colour sprites, named <material>_alpha

effectors.decision: written with type 0 and sizeMultiplier 0, so no opcode 4: the 727 client reads effector opcode 4 as a bare int where Jagex's files hold a byte and an int, so the type is never read and the multiplier's low byte becomes the next opcode (RS3's type 2 / multiplier 1 made it opcode 1 and a rotation of 2057, which overruns COSINE[rotation shl 3]); the client's type is always 0, and the multiplier only matters to types 1 and 2, so nothing the client can draw is lost
